name: /worktree
display_name: Run a chat in a Git worktree
description: Run the current chat in a new Git worktree, so Codex works on a second checkout of the repository instead of the local checkout. Worktrees let several independent chats run against one project at the same time, and Handoff moves a chat between Local and Worktree. This control is offered in the ChatGPT desktop app and IDE composer; the Codex CLI documents no worktree command.

examples.explanation: Move the current chat onto a new Git worktree.

when_to_use: Queue background work on a branch while you keep the local checkout free for your own foreground work.
Run several Codex chats against one repository without them fighting over the same checkout.
when_not_to_use: Git only allows a branch to be checked out in one place at a time, so hand the chat back to Local before checking that branch out yourself.
The Codex CLI has no worktree command; reach for this from the desktop app or IDE composer.

conditions: Requires a project inside a Git repository.
Not available in the Codex CLI.
